# optimizelycmssaas_property_group (Data Source)

Looks up an existing property_group by key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "optimizelycmssaas_property_group" "content" {
  key = "Content"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Key of the property_group to look up.

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) Name shown in the editor.
- `sort_order` (Number) Position when sorting property groups. Assigned by the CMS when unset.
